questions.question: What is the unit digit of 178 × 593 + 157?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

178 × 593 + 157

Formula used:

Unit digit of a number is the digit in the one's place of the number.

**Calculation:**

178 × 593 + 157

⇒ 178 × 593 + 157

⇒ 105554

What is the value of 3¹ + 3⁻¹ + 3² + 3⁻²?
A number when divided by 16 leaves remainder 8. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 8?
questions.solution:
Let the number be x.

We know that,

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

⇒ x = 16 × 1 + 8

⇒ x = 24

When 24 is divided by 8, the remainder will be zero. Because 24 is completely divisible by 8.

questions.question: Which of the given value is completely divisible by 12?
questions.solution:
When a number is divisible by 3 and 4, then the number is always divisible by 12.

**Rule for 3 **- When the sum of digits is divisible by 3, then the number will always divisible by 3.

**Rule for 4 **- When the last two digits of number is divisible by 4, then the number will always divisible by 4.

⇒ Sum of digits of 3470 = 14, which is not divisible by 3.

⇒ Sum of digits of 7236 = 18 which is divisible by 3 and the last two digits is divisible by 4.

⇒ Sum of digits of 1426 = 13, which is not divisible by 3.

⇒ Sum of digits of 2427 = 15, divisible by 3 but last two digits are not divisible by 4.

Hence, 7236 is divisible by 12.

questions.question: X, Y and Z can complete a work in 15, 45 and 90 days respectively. In how many days X, Y and Z together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
X can complete the work in 15 days

⇒ X’s one day work = 1/15

Y can complete the work in 45 days

⇒ Y’s one day work = 1/45

Z can complete the work in 90 days

⇒ Z’s one day work = 1/90

⇒ X + Y + Z = (1/15 + 1/45 + 1/90)

⇒ X + Y + Z = (6 + 2 + 1)/90 = 1/10

∴ (X + Y + Z) together can complete the work in 10 days

questions.question: U, V and W together can complete a work in 15 days. U alone can complete the work in 60 days. In how many days V and W together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given,

(U + V + W) can complete a work in 15 days.

⇒ (U + V + W)’s one day work = 1/15

U alone can complete the work in 60 days.

⇒ U’s one day work = 1/60

⇒ (V + W)’s one day work = (1/15 - 1/60) = (4 - 1)/60 = 1/20

V + W can complete the same work in 20 days.

questions.question: If the diagonal of a square is 10 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of the square?

questions.question: Marked price of an article is 30% more than its cost price. If 30% discount is given, then what will be the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the Cost price be Rs. x.

Then, MP = x + 0.3x = 1.3x

After giving discount, we get

⇒ SP = 1.3x - (0.3 × 1.3x) = 0.91x

Loss % = frac{{CP - SP}}{{CP}} times 100

⇒ Loss % = frac{{x - 0.91x}}{x} times 100 = 9\%

questions.question: After giving a discount of 40% on an article, shopkeeper gains 25%. Marked price is how much percent more than the cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the marked price of an article be Rs. X

⇒ SP = x - 0.4x = 0.6x

⇒ Gain % = frac{{SP - CP}}{{CP}} times 100

Rightarrow 25 = frac{{SP - CP}}{{CP}} times 100

⇒ CP = 0.48x

Now,

⇒ MP - CP = x - 0.48x = 0.52x

⇒ % Increase = frac{{0.52x}}{{0.48x}} times 100 = 108.33\%

questions.question: 200 is divided into two parts in such a way that the sixth part of the first and the half part of the second are in the ratio 1 ∶ 1. What will be the value of the second part?
questions.solution:
Let the two parts be x and y.

Rightarrow ({frac{x)/(6)}}{{(y)/(2)}} = (1)/(1)

Rightarrow (x)/({3y)} = (1)/(1)

Rightarrow (x)/(y) = (3)/(1)

Now,

⇒ x + y = 200

Let x = 3a and y = a

⇒ 3a + a = 200

⇒ a = 50

The value of second part = y = 50

questions.question: Two rice of prices 60 Rs/kg and 80 Rs/kg are mixed in the ratio of 3 ∶ 2. What will be the price (in Rs/kg) of mixture?
questions.solution:
Let the quantity of two types of rice be 3x and 2x

Then, the price of 3x kg of rice = 60 × 3x = 180x

And the price of 2x kg of rice = 80 × 2x = 160x

The price of mixture = frac{{160x + 180x}}{{3x + 2x}} = frac{{340x}}{{5x}} = Rs. 68

questions.question: Average of 7 consecutive numbers is A. If 2 numbers which are before these 7 numbers are also taken, then what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
Let the 7 consecutive number be (x - 3), (x - 2), (x - 1), (x), (x + 1), (x + 2), (x + 3)

The sum of above consecutive number = 7x

⇒ Average of numbers = The sum of above consecutive number/7 = A

⇒ x = A

After adding 2 numbers which are before these 7 numbers, we get

The numbers are (x - 5), (x - 4), (x - 3), (x - 2), (x - 1), (x), (x + 1), (x + 2), (x + 3)

⇒ Sum = 9x - 9

Average = 9(x - 1)/9 = x - 1 = A - 1

questions.question: An article is purchased for Rs. 4200 and sold for Rs. 4830. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
The cost price of an article = Rs. 4200

The selling price of an article = Rs. 4830

Profit = 4830 - 4200 = 630

Profit% = frac{{Profit}}{{CP}} times 100 = frac{{630}}{{4200}} times 100 = 15\%

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 4800 at a loss of 20%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
We know that,

⇒ Loss% = frac{{CP - SP}}{{CP}} times 100

Rightarrow 20 = frac{{CP - SP}}{{CP}} times 100

⇒ CP/SP = 5/4

Let CP be 5x and SP be 4X.

Then, SP = 4800

⇒ 4x = 4800

⇒ x = 1200

⇒ CP = 5x = 5 × 1200 = 6000

Hence, CP = Rs.6000

questions.question: Rs. 3500 are invested for 3 years in a scheme of simple interest at a rate of 16% per annum. What will be the amount (in Rs.) obtained after 3 years?
questions.solution:

SI = (PRT/100)

⇒ SI = (3500 × 16 × 3)/100

⇒ SI = 1680

Amount = Principal + Interest
